basic_info_description:
Built in 1904, this grand Presidio Heights home has had a succession of proud owners who have carefully retained the integrity of the architecture of its time.  For those interested in seeing how the home's large, inviting rooms could be reimagined to reflect a contemporary lifestyle and popular décor while still retaining the original design’s graceful proportions and sense of balance, the  4 renderings with captions 'REIMAGINED' are a suggested approach for the entry hall, living room, & great room (achieved by combining the kitchen and dining room).
     This handsome Georgian-style residence is located in one of San Francisco’s most prestigious neighborhoods, featuring graceful proportions, a sense of balance & elegant finishes throughout. Substantial seismic upgrades completed in 1994.
     The gated entry with honed marble walk-way leads to a gracious portico with etched glass panels that provides a glimpse of the garden beyond and a geometric limestone roundel in the floor and a mahogany front door.
    A grand foyer showcasing an elegant staircase is light-filled thanks to a leaded glass window and skylight.  Hardwood flooring that flows through much of the main level, stunning woodwork, and high ceilings reflect a bygone era. Generous wall space is ideal for displaying large pieces of art.
    The spacious living room has a fireplace and three picture.   Extra recessed lighting bathes the generous wall space for art. Adjacent to the living room is a library with floor-to-ceiling book. The elegant dining room features an ornate coffered ceiling, fireplace with a marble surround and wood mantle and easily accommodates a grand piano.
     The large eating area in the kitchen opens through French doors to an inviting deck overlooking the garden below.  The kitchen is designed for those who love to cook, well appointed for entertaining large parties yet com-fortable for day-to-day living.  An oversized center island and abundant cabinetry in a high gloss white provide a striking contrast with the onyx marble counter tops.  
     The master bedroom suite enjoys spectacular views of the G. G. Bridge & Bay and opens to a generous sitting room with a fireplace, separate his and her bathrooms, and individual custom fitted dressing rooms.  The 2nd bedroom is highlighted by a fireplace with a decorative marble mantle and surround & bathroom en-suite.  The 3rd bedroom is currently used as an office.  
     On the upper level, a fabulous family/media room spans the north side of the residence with panoramic views of the Bridge and Bay.  The room has a wet bar with an under-counter refrigerator and is wired for surround sound. Two spacious bedrooms with generous closet space and bathrooms en-suite complete this floor.  This level is serviced by an elevator from the garden level that also services the main and second floor.
Garden Level:  A versatile recreation/exercise room can be conveniently accessed directly from garden and has a powder room   The 6th bedroom includes a bedroom and .bathroom. This level has convenient egress to the driveway, garage and side entrance to suit all needs. The garden is a welcoming place to entertain, transformed to a level yard by elevating the ground six feet with new retaining walls..  A checkerboard pattern of grass with granite cobble stones, and a gravel border was designed to allow for drainage during the rainy season.  An outdoor amphitheater with seats terraced into the landscape and a movie screen slips between cleverly crafted bronze bamboo poles.  The bamboo theme is carried out in the borders of the yard, up-lit to create a dramatic ambience at night.  A fully-equipped outdoor kitchen which is hidden from view and protected by etched glass panels.  The kitchen has a large BBQ, warming drawer, two under-counter refrigerators, granite countertops and sink.  Substantial glass and bronze doors lead guests to a walkway to exit the property.
